description: Record an expense or additional income in Quipu. Use it to log supplier bills and deductible costs. Assign an `accounting_category_id` whenever you know it — an uncategorised expense still counts for VAT but is useless for the profit and loss breakdown.

accounting_category_id.description: Id of the accounting category to file this entry under

contact_id.description: Id of the related Quipu contact, if any

retention_percent.description: IRPF withholding percentage, if it applies

kind.description: Entry kind as accepted by Quipu (e.g. "expense", "income")

name: create_additional_income
